description: A small alert asking for a group's name: making a new group, or renaming one. Also reached from a session's Move to Group → New Group…, where the chat is moved into the new group.
opens: session row right-click → Move to Group → New Group…

parts.name: name field
parts.shows: A single text field, empty for a new group, else holding the group's current name; focused. Enter confirms. Spaces are tidied; a blank name does nothing.

parts.name: Create / Rename
parts.shows: The default, suggested-style button: "Create" for a new group, "Rename" for a rename.

actions.does: The group is made and listed in ⋮ → Groups even while empty; if the dialog came from Move to Group, that chat is moved into it. A name already in use joins that group.
The group's chats move to the new name (and it stays listed if it was); to a group already there, they join it. No change if the name is unchanged.

states.name: group explanation
states.shows: A new group is explained as: "A list of chats of its own, picked in ⋮ → Groups; a chat's right-click → Move to Group puts it there" (copy new_session.group_body, shown where the same form is used for a host's new session, not in this dialog).
